summary: Implemented the missing emitter API in src/emitter.ts: `on` now returns an unsubscribe function (idempotent, delegates to `off`); added `off` (removes one listener by reference via indexOf/splice), `once` (wraps the listener so it self-removes before running, returns a cancel function), and `listenerCount`. `emit` now runs all listeners from a snapshot, catches per-listener errors, and rethrows the first error after all have run. Verification: `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test` exits 0 — typecheck clean, all 6 tests pass. No changes to test/, types-test/, or tsconfig.json.
